content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe provides a robust payment processing solution in 46 countries, but its absence in Nigeria is glaring. PayPal offers some functionality, yet account suspensions can freeze funds for up to 180 days, leaving creators in financial limbo. Platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also restrict access, prioritizing markets where they can ensure compliance and reduce risk over accessibility. In contrast, sovereign commerce stacks, like those offered by COREMERCH, provide complete freedom. These stacks enable creators to set up their own payment and delivery systems using tools like NOWPayments, which support over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing access to a global market without intermediary restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

While Stripe and PayPal actively exclude creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and other restricted countries, alternative platforms often follow suit due to compliance and financial risks. These limitations create a cycle that keeps creators from fully utilizing their potential. Sovereign commerce infrastructure confronts this issue head-on by allowing creators to own their payment processing and delivery mechanisms. With solutions like COREMERCH’s Starter and Edge Commerce Stacks, creators can deploy their stores and accept payments in cryptocurrencies, bypassing traditional banking limitations altogether. This approach not only mitigates the risk of account freezes but also ensures creators have complete control over their transactions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms like PayPal and Stripe can impose high fees and slow transaction times, often leading to frustration. PayPal can hold funds for extended periods, and Stripe's fees can accumulate quickly, especially for smaller transactions. In contrast, using NOWPayments with COREMERCH stacks incurs only a 0.5% fee, with transactions typically confirmed in minutes. This efficiency not only maximizes creators' profits but also ensures they receive funds promptly. For creators in Nigeria, this represents a significant shift from the slow, restrictive payment processes offered by conventional platforms to a fluid, efficient system that promotes financial agency.
Take control of your digital sales with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key advantages of sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership. Unlike platforms that control your data and access, solutions like COREMERCH ensure that creators retain full ownership of their digital stores and customer data after deployment. Automation is built in, with tools like Google Apps Script handling backend logic and product delivery seamlessly. By utilizing free hosting and storage solutions, creators can focus on their products without worrying about platform fees or compliance issues. This level of control empowers creators to scale and adapt their businesses as they see fit.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When deciding on a digital commerce stack, consider your specific needs. If you want a quick setup and have fewer products, the Sovereign Starter Stack is an excellent choice at $97. For those with more complex needs and a larger catalog, the Edge Commerce Stack at $197 offers greater functionality and support. The Complete Builder Kit, priced at $197, includes all blueprints and templates, providing everything needed for a comprehensive setup. This choice ensures that you have the right tools to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce effectively.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Bypass traditional payment restrictions and unlock your potential.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
